title: Elon Musk takes aim at Delta for refusing to use Starlink for Wi-Fi

title: OpenAI's Dots connect to 4,000 apps and never sleep
summary: OpenAI just unveiled Dots: an always-on AI assistant with 4,000+ tools that might just be the closest thing yet to Tony Stark's "Jarvis."
